name: Athaliah
description: Queen living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: When Athaliah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal: a mother giving orders to kill anybody next in line, because her power came through her son. Back then a woman was only empowered based on the man; America is empowering you directly now.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw her son was dead, she moved to destroy all the royal seed so she could seize the throne.

note.label: 2 Kings 11: The Hidden King and the Covenant to Be the Lord's People

points: Jehosheba, sister of Ahaziah, took the infant Joash and stole him away from among the king's sons who were being slain, hiding him in the house of the Most High for six years while Athaliah reigned.

note.label: 2 Kings 11: The Hidden King and the Covenant to Be the Lord's People

points: Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and the people and came into the temple, and saw the king standing by a pillar as the manner was.

note.label: 2 Kings 11: The Hidden King and the Covenant to Be the Lord's People

points: Athaliah rent her clothes and cried, Treason, Treason. She just killed all the royal seed, and when they anoint the rightful king, she screams treason. When you try to restore order, that's how some women look at you, like it's treason against them; they don't see that they're out of order.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Ahaziah was forty and two years old when he began to reign and reigned one year in Jerusalem, and his mother's name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.

This is a warning against being ruled by the wrong counsel: instead of going to the priests and the judges, he went to his mother, and she counselled him into ruin. A woman with a grudge can rule a kingdom through her son, and that is what Athaliah did.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 22: Ahaziah and the Rise of Athaliah

points: When Athaliah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah, killing the king's sons.
Athaliah did not carry out this slaughter alone; she had weak men helping her run over everything, which is how she seized and held the throne.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 22: Ahaziah and the Rise of Athaliah

points: She hid the child in the house of God six years while Athaliah reigned over the land, showing that Athaliah was ruling in the position of the son she had lost.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 22: Ahaziah and the Rise of Athaliah

points: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came into the house of the Most High and saw the king standing at his pillar with the princes, trumpets, and singers rejoicing.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: The sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the house of God and bestowed all its dedicated things upon Baalim, which is why so much repair was needed.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 24: Joash Repairs the House and Then Falls
